use_case_summary: Primary: in-product assistant (chat) for customer analytics product. Secondary: semantic doc search for help center + embeddings for reranking. High read-dominant traffic; occasional long-context uploads for summarization.
capacity_requirements: Observed during hosted trial: baseline 8 QPS sustained, peak 45 QPS during weekday mornings, average concurrency 40 streams during peak 30-minute windows. Token mix: 70% short exchanges (<150 tokens), 25% mid (150-1k), 5% long-form uploads (1k-20k). Target for Dedicated: support steady 60 QPS with 200 concurrency headroom and 2x burst capacity for 10 minutes.
performance_targets: Latency SLO: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 220ms for typical chat (<=512 tokens). Throughput target: 60 QPS sustained. Cost target: blended per-token cost comparable to hosted with <10% premium for Dedicated SLA.
poC_acceptance_criteria: 1) p95 latency under 220ms for sample prompt set at 60 QPS sustained; 2) no request failures under 0.1% during 2-hour soak; 3) end-to-end security checklist (SAML + KMS) validated in staging; 4) cost estimate within forecasted ARR band.
commercial_notes: Interested in 12-month reserved capacity if Dedicated sizing proves out. Requested three pricing scenarios: 1) baseline reserved (60 QPS), 2) baseline + 2x burst, 3) flexible autoscale with commit. Wants clear breakout for token types and KV cache effectiveness. Finance prefers commit-to-consumption with monthly true-up.
